reviews.text: All staff from reception to vets are very friendly,professional and make both you and your pet feel at ease.  I travel around 5 miles to this practice.  Think that says it all.

Quick efficient and friendly staff from reception through to vets. Percy had a booster and nails clipped, the young vet reassured Percy with gently saying he was a good boy. Would recommend Armley vets.

The BEST! The staff are so friendly and nice and poor Harriet has dealt with so many phone calls from me asking the most absurd questions about our cats (we worry A LOT about our babies!). The vets are always professional and kind and make a big fuss over the cats. Thank you so much!

Thank you to all the staff at Armley. The procedure was clearly explained and any questions I had were answered fully. Jasper was well cared for and looked very handsome in his cone when I came to collect him!
The service and help from the vets was very good  so friendly
Lovely vets helped Tommy yesterday always polite and happy to help
It is so friendly and my little dog likes it
Really friendly and really explain things well. Great vets
What a pleasant experience.  Reception ladies lovely and the vet was really funny.  And my poorly cat is much better 😊
When I arrive the staff are really lovely and friendly I am happy to go their would recommend
Looked after our cat beautifully. Explained everything to us about the operation she had and what we need to do ect. Very friendly staff
The staff are so kind and caring and the vet was just brilliant with my little dog, I highly recommend this practice!

All staff are friendly and welcoming.

Billie is wonderful I can't thank her enough. Xxx
Wonderful staff, always very kind and caring . Highly recommend Yorkshire Vets
Eevee's usually quite grumpy coming to the vets but Billie is absolutely excellent with her. Couldn't recommend this practice higher
Friendly, caring staff who care about my furry friends xxx
Really friendly branch. Everyone you speak to is lovely. Billie the vet is excellent, has such a way with animals and owners. We have three cats that are treated very well by the team.
Very polite and helpful staff.
We couldn't recommend this vet practice highly enough. All the members of staff are so kind and welcoming and they go above and beyond for our dog. Excellent service

Vet was recommended by a friend who also has cats. Only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is because the prices are above average despite being in an impoverished area.
Everything else was fantastic! The vet (Billie) was great, explaining everything and answering all my questions. She provided an estimate of the cost of dental work that Stanley needs, without me having to ask. And she gave good advice about the Pet Plan that I subscribed to on the day. The ladies on reception were exceptionally friendly and helpful too. The whole experience made me feel that Stanley is going to be a well looked after cat in their hands 😻

We had to take our lovely dog Rosco to Yorkshire Vets over the past week for scans and tests after his health suddenly deteriorated. Unfortunately, we then had to make the heartbreaking decision to have him put to sleep.

Despite how devastating the situation was, the team at Yorkshire Vets made the experience as kind and compassionate as it possibly could have been. The receptionists were absolutely amazing and even managed to get Rosco to eat some treats in the waiting room on his final day, which meant so much to us. The medication they gave him the day before also meant we were able to have one last really special day with him - he was comfortable, able to eat, go for a walk, and just be himself again for a little while.

The vet looking after him was incredibly understanding, gentle and compassionate throughout. When the time came, both the vet and vet nurse made his final moments peaceful and dignified. We were able to hold him, and it truly felt like he just fell asleep calmly and comfortably in our arms.

They went above and beyond not only in the care they gave Rosco, but also in the support they gave us during one of the hardest moments imaginable. They were really understanding about our financed in an awful situation and helped massively with this. We will always be grateful to them for giving him such a peaceful and loving goodbye.
Got caught in a rain shower and they dried him with a fluffy pink towel. Thorough examination, diagnosed the problem and he is much better thank you.
Jasper is always stressed visiting the vets but the lovely nurse puts him at ease, he pants away but soon relaxes

My dog is weeing in the house at 10 year old and I was bringing him in on my only day off in weeks that I was able to. I arrived 7 minutes past my appointment time as I was told to try and catch a wee sample to bring in, which isn’t easy and hadn’t happened by then. When I came in I was told we couldn’t have him seen, and when I explained I was trying to get the sample outside, one of the front desk women said “that’s unfortunate”. I’ll find a new vet after all of these years. Super inconsiderate and not adjusting for those of us who suffer from anxiety to boot.

Most importantly the staff love their job, they love to chat to you about your pet/s
Our pets are part of our families and we only trust those who treat them as such😄
I feel this every time I visit👍🤗
All of the above again as I had to return with another pet , the genuine warmth, care and empathy radiates through to your pet and this is what they need 😍
Always a delight to visit. My dog loves it here and I really trust the vets, nurses and other staff.

The vets at Yorkshire vets are all amazing. My cat is quite spicy and does not allow people to look at her without sedation. They are so professional, calm and confident which makes a huge different to my cat and to me. Super grateful for all their hard work and dedication and especially their love for animals.
So happy today. Billy who is the vet was excellent with my anxious chow chow. The reception ladies were very helpful and so kind. Overall a lovely experience, thank you.

The vets, nurses and reception team are absolutely fantastic here! After a bad experience with a well known vets I was recommended endlessly to go to Yorkshire vets armley and Im so glad I took their advice.

I first took my cat Conker who was randomly throwing up after eating to see Billie after id just found out my other cat Sukki had kidney disease so I was a mess as you can imagine. Billie was so kind and understanding and made sure she checked everything and talked me through everything and treated conker like he was her own and solved the problem with an anti sickness injection.

I've recently taken Sukki who has kidney disease for his bloods/urine tests and saw Emily and she was fantastic! So knowledgeable and kind, sukki definitely approved! She again was so nice and talked me through everything.

The reception team were friendly and very complimentary of both of my sons and made us all feel so special!

Will never go anywhere else, price is absolutely fair for the services, knowledge and experience at Yorkshire Vets!

Thank you again so much!
Avoid at all costs!

Excellent service
Very caring and supportive

Billie Bennett is excellent.
Very friendly people.They show they care about all the animals that visit the practice.Vets have a nice manner with dogs (dog owner).Would highly recommend them.
Excellent, really kind and friendly staff, can you believe my little dog loves going there
The best service and my two kittens purred their way through injections and microchipping! Vet Billie was incredible. Highly recommended! Thank you so much ☺️
Very helpful lady vet,really liked my dog and he her was so relaxed fell asleep
Very good here with pets go above and beyond to help your pets thank you.
Been going to yorkshire vets now for a very long time the staff are always friendly and very helpful always greet my  dog Cody and cats milo and felix with a friendly welcome would highly recommend
Great service, friendly staff. The practice is clean and always welcoming.
Staff always welcoming and friendly.  Billie is the most amazing vet
Amazing. All the vets are kind and helpful. My dog (dudley) was in and out within 5 minutes.
Excellent staff and vet. Has kept our 15 year old Westie in first class health.
it's always a friendly service with a smile. I have been taking my feline family members there for over 20 years and trust them with everything.
I live in Castleford and this is my go too vets, all the staff are very friendly
